function.name: get_weather_forecast
function.description: Retrieves the weather forecast for a specified location and date range. The forecast includes temperature, precipitation, and wind speed. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location for which the weather forecast is requested, in the format of 'City, Country' (e.g., 'London, UK').

start_date.description: The start date of the period for the weather forecast in the ISO 8601 format (e.g., '2023-04-01').

end_date.description: The end date of the period for the weather forecast in the ISO 8601 format (e.g., '2023-04-07').

units.description: The unit system in which to return the weather forecast data.

include_details.description: Specifies whether to include detailed forecast information such as humidity and visibility.

### How Turbonomics Helps Unilever Leverage AI for Multi‑Cloud Observability | Goal | What Turbonomics Provides | Why It Matters for Unilever | |------|---------------------------|-----------------------------| | **Unified Visibility Across All Clouds** | • A single pane of glass that aggregates metrics from GCP, AWS, Azure, on‑prem, and edge environments.
• Real‑time dashboards that surface performance, cost, and capacity across all workloads. | Unilever can see the health of its global supply‑chain, marketing, and e‑commerce workloads in one place, eliminating the “cloud‑silos” problem. | | **AI‑Driven Root‑Cause Analysis** | • Machine‑learning models that automatically correlate events, logs, and metrics to pinpoint the source of latency, errors, or cost spikes.
• Predictive alerts before problems become outages. | Faster incident response means less downtime for Unilever’s retail platforms and better customer experience. | | **Dynamic Resource Optimization** | • Continuous optimization engine that reallocates compute, storage, and network resources based on real‑time demand and cost signals.
• Automated scaling policies that respect SLAs while minimizing waste. | Unilever can keep its workloads running at peak efficiency, reducing cloud spend by up to 30–40 % while maintaining performance. | | **Policy‑Based Governance** | • Centralized policy engine that enforces compliance, security, and cost‑control rules across all clouds.
• Auditable logs and automated remediation. | Ensures Unilever’s data‑privacy and regulatory requirements are met consistently across regions. | | **Cost Forecasting & Budgeting** | • AI models that predict future spend based on usage patterns, upcoming campaigns, or seasonal demand.
• Scenario planning tools to evaluate “what‑if” changes. | Enables Unilever’s finance teams to plan budgets accurately and avoid surprise bills. | | **Seamless Integration with Existing Tooling** | • APIs and connectors for Kubernetes, Terraform, CI/CD pipelines, and monitoring stacks (Prometheus, Grafana, etc.).
• Plug‑in for existing DevOps workflows. | Unilever can adopt Turbonomics without disrupting its current DevOps practices. | #### How It Works in Practice 1. **Data Collection** – Turbonomics pulls telemetry from each cloud provider’s APIs, as well as from on‑prem hypervisors and edge devices. 2. **Normalization** – All metrics are mapped to a common schema (CPU, memory, I/O, cost per hour). 3. **AI Engine** – Uses supervised learning (historical data) and reinforcement learning (real‑time feedback) to: * Detect anomalies, * Predict future resource needs, * Recommend or auto‑apply optimizations. 4. **Action Layer** – Executes API calls to scale, migrate, or terminate resources, or to trigger alerts/notifications. 5. **Governance Layer** – Enforces policies and logs every change for auditability. --- ### Difference Between Turbonomics and Native Cloud Tools (GCP, AWS, Azure) | Feature | Turbonomics | Native Cloud Tool (GCP/AWS/Azure) | |---------|-------------|-----------------------------------| | **Scope** | Cross‑cloud + on‑prem + edge | Single‑cloud only | | **Observability** | Unified dashboards, AI‑driven root‑cause, predictive analytics | Cloud‑specific dashboards; limited cross‑cloud correlation | | **Optimization** | Continuous, AI‑driven resource reallocation, cost‑aware scaling | Manual scaling or basic autoscaling; cost optimization often requires separate services (e.g., AWS Cost Explorer) | | **Governance** | Central policy engine, audit trails, automated remediation | Policies exist but are cloud‑specific; cross‑cloud governance requires multiple tools | | **Integration** | APIs for Kubernetes, Terraform, CI/CD, monitoring stacks | Native APIs; integration may require custom scripts or third‑party tools | | **Cost Forecasting** | AI‑based forecasting, scenario planning | Basic cost reports; forecasting usually manual or via separate analytics services | | **Learning Curve** | One platform to learn; plug‑ins for existing tools | Multiple vendor consoles; each has its own UI/UX | | **Vendor Lock‑In** | Vendor‑agnostic; reduces lock‑in risk | Tied to a single cloud provider’s ecosystem | #### Quick Comparison Example | Use Case | Turbonomics | GCP Operations (formerly Stackdriver) | AWS CloudWatch | Azure Monitor | |----------|-------------|---------------------------------------|----------------|---------------| | **Multi‑cloud alerting** | Yes, unified alerts | No, per‑project | No, per‑account | No, per‑subscription | | **Auto‑scale across clouds** | Yes, AI‑driven | No, per‑region | No, per‑region | No, per‑region | | **Cost optimization** | AI recommendations, budget alerts | Cost Explorer, budgets | Cost Explorer, budgets | Cost Management, budgets | | **Root‑cause analysis** | AI correlation across all workloads | Basic log correlation | Basic log correlation | Basic log correlation | --- ### Bottom Line for Unilever - **Unified View**: Turbonomics gives Unilever a single, AI‑powered view of all its workloads, regardless of where they run. - **Operational Efficiency**: AI continuously optimizes resources, freeing IT teams to focus on innovation rather than manual tuning. - **Cost Control**: Predictive cost forecasting and automated optimization reduce waste and give finance teams confidence in budgeting. - **Governance & Compliance**: Central policy enforcement ensures Unilever meets regulatory requirements across all regions. By adopting Turbonomics, Unilever can transform its multi‑cloud environment from a collection of isolated silos into a cohesive, intelligent ecosystem that delivers performance, cost savings, and agility—something native cloud tools alone cannot achieve without significant custom integration and manual effort.
